_note: Fox Dojo doors timings, in seconds; distances in 1920x1080 pixels.

title._note: pass_s is one line's crossing; the lower line follows the upper one by stagger_s; the doors open tail_s after the lower line's crossing. drift is how far a line creeps either side of the middle; out_at is the part of a crossing when the line speeds off. The path is curve_cubic * u^3 + curve_quintic * u^5 of the crossing.

trail._note: the streak behind a fast line: it shows above min_speed_px_per_s and is full speed_range_px_per_s above that; each copy sits spacing_s of travel behind the previous one
